patterns.note: Full-bleed, dark-toned background imagery (video or static) is consistently used for major content sections, with text overlaid for an immersive and dramatic presentation.
Large, bold, sans-serif headings are used for section titles, creating a strong visual hierarchy against lighter, smaller body text.
A dominant dark charcoal background provides a high-contrast canvas for stark white and light grey typography, reinforcing a serious and sophisticated tone.
The hero background image parallaxes subtly on scroll, while subsequent content sections reveal their text with a fade-in or slide-up effect as they enter the viewport.
Each major content block is introduced by a large, centered heading, often paired with a full-width, relevant background image or video that sets the context.

technique_notes: The hero section features a full-bleed video background with a dark, semi-transparent overlay to ensure text readability, and the video itself exhibits a subtle parallax scroll effect.
Content sections below the hero utilize full-width, high-resolution background images or solid dark panels, with text content positioned for clear legibility against the background.

Scroll-triggered animations are used to reveal text and other content elements, typically appearing with a gentle fade-in or slide-up motion as their respective sections become visible in the viewport.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, impactful sans-serif headings are significantly larger and bolder than the lighter, smaller body text, establishing a clear visual hierarchy.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero, creating a sense of gravitas and clarity

standout: The site's distinctive use of high-quality, dark-toned, full-bleed imagery and video as immersive backgrounds for every major content section, combined with a stark, minimal typography, creates an exceptionally serious, authoritative, and almost cinematic user experience that feels far from a generic template. The pixelated 'A' logo is also a unique brand element.
